'''Jynx''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During that time the Gungan accompanied a spacer to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and possibly other [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Meesa thinks you and Jynx is gonna be the bestest of friends!|In-game shop description|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
Jynx is a sidekick [[:w:c:cwa:Companion|companion]] for players in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. The Gungan sidekick can be bought for 300 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]] from the in-game shop and follows the player around on their adventures.
